brief: A finite state machine kept in the engine: add states and transitions, send events, and read the state the machine is in.
detail: Declare the states, then the transitions as [ from, event, to ]. Send follows the matching transition and answers the new state. The first state added is the starting state. Mistakes are not reported by the machine: an event that matches no transition, a SetState to an unknown state and a transition naming an unknown state are all ignored without an error, so check CurrentState after the call that matters.
